name: Burnout: Overtime and deadlines
description: A simulator of a conversation with a manager under strict deadlines. Learn to assertively defend your own boundaries, negotiate compromises and prevent professional burnout.

start.text: I looked at your reports for the last week.  The indicators have fallen, and in general, your involvement in the project is now minimal.

options.text: I understand that the project is currently in...

boss_confrontation.text: Is it difficult for you alone?  We all work in this rhythm!

options.text: If working in the company means full...
I understand your position, but the accusations…
Let's see which tasks are really critical.
It is the task of management to plan interchangeability...

exit_burnout_1.text: If you make such important decisions on emotions because of the first request for help, then we really have nothing to talk about.  Application on the table.

exit_burnout_2.text: Your attitude towards processes is completely unprofessional.  I am not capable of working with a person who does not care about the team.

boss_transit.text: (Sighs) I'm on edge too with these deadlines, so I talk too tough.  It's good that you spoke directly about your condition, and did not just silently block the deadline on Monday.

options.text: Let me review the assignment right now.

compromise_deal.text: This is a good option.  If you prepare the base today and start earlier on Monday, we will have time to show the demo to the client at 12:00.

options.text: I won't have time for anything today...

constructive_negotiation.text: Your arguments sound rational, but if this unit is not ready on Monday at nine in the morning, the client will terminate the contract.  I can't risk the project.

options.text: Let me right now, until the end...
It's not my problem that in...
If the situation is critical, I am ready to help...

boss_deep_connection.text: You offer a great way out.  Your plan with Oleg really saves the situation, and I can see your responsibility even in a state of fatigue.

boss_neutral_end.text: OK.  Let's leave everything as it is until Monday.

boss_happy_end.text: Thank you  This conversation helped me look at the situation not only through the prism of deadlines, but also through respect for human resources.
